videoMetadata.title: The BEST Items To Counter EVERY Hero In Deadlock

summary.intro: Most Deadlock guides focus on countering heroes individually, but this approach teaches you to build smarter by using items that counter multiple heroes and entire team compositions at once. Instead of memorizing single matchups, you'll learn which items give the most value against the majority of teams you face.

passiveItems.name: Reactive Barrier
passiveItems.effect: Automatically activates when you get hit by any form of crowd control, creating a barrier
passiveItems.tips: No-brainer to buy as early as the laning phase into teams with lots of CC
passiveItems.useCase: Insanely good against heroes that rely on locking you down before finishing the job

passiveItems.name: Debuff Reducer
passiveItems.effect: Reduces the duration of stuns, slows and even ultimates that apply CC effects
passiveItems.tips: Builds into Debuff Remover, a fantastic active
passiveItems.useCase: Perfect if you're tired of being stunlocked or stuck in crowd control each fight

passiveItems.name: Spirit Shielding
passiveItems.effect: Heavily increases your survivability against spirit damage
passiveItems.tips: One of the best early game pickups if you're dealing with lots of spirit heroes
passiveItems.useCase: Great value into double spirit lanes

passiveItems.name: Spirit Resilience
passiveItems.effect: Stat-based passive that fine-tunes your defense based on what the enemy team's running
passiveItems.tips: Not an early game item. Buy it once you have the core items needed to deal damage. Press Tab and see if majority of enemy team has spirit damage
passiveItems.useCase: Fine-tune your defense based on enemy team composition

passiveItems.name: Bullet Resilience
passiveItems.effect: Stat-based passive that fine-tunes your defense against weapon damage. Also good into melee heroes (bullet resist translates to melee resist 1:1)
passiveItems.tips: Worse than Spirit Resilience because Armor-Piercing Rounds exist (50% chance to ignore bullet resist). No equivalent for spirit. Consider Battle Vest (cheaper, adds fire rate) or Plated Armor (double price but deflects bullets and on-hit effects)
passiveItems.useCase: Good against weapon-heavy teams and melee heroes like Infernus

passiveItems.name: Battle Vest
passiveItems.effect: Offers bullet resistance and fire rate
passiveItems.tips: Good for heroes that build on damage like Haze

passiveItems.name: Plated Armor
passiveItems.effect: Can deflect bullets and on-hit effects
passiveItems.tips: Double the price of Battle Vest but the difference is very noticeable
passiveItems.useCase: Useful against heroes who try to build up on-hit effects

passiveItems.name: Spellbreaker
passiveItems.effect: Provides insane spirit resist and debuff resist
passiveItems.tips: Best spirit resist option in the game. Can make heroes like Grey Talon useless
passiveItems.useCase: Whenever you need spirit resist, this is the best option

activeItems.name: Counterspell
activeItems.effect: Transforms your parry to protect you from the damaging effects of enemy abilities and items. Time the parry just before an ability reaches you
activeItems.tips: One of the few items that can be bought every game on any hero. Note: Counterspelling Bebop's bomb puts it on cooldown but he still gains a stack
activeItems.useCase: Almost every ability in the game becomes useless against someone who has mastered counterspell

activeItems.name: Rebuttal
activeItems.effect: On a successful parry against an enemy hero, you heal, return the damage, and temporarily gain 30% bonus damage for 6 seconds
activeItems.tips: Whenever you land one parry, they're as good as dead. You can also parry Puddle Punch from Viscous
activeItems.useCase: Turn successful parries into kill opportunities

activeItems.name: Knockdown
activeItems.effect: Drops an anvil on someone's head, knocking them down and stunning them. Prevents and cancels many ultimates
activeItems.tips: Absolute menace against flying characters or anyone mid-animation. Hit Moe and Krill with knockdown when they're constantly burrowing
activeItems.useCase: Cancel ultimates and punish flying heroes

activeItems.name: Slowing Hex
activeItems.effect: Massively reduces enemy movement and silences their movement-based abilities and items for over 3 seconds
activeItems.tips: You're going to have impact with this item almost every game. Getting slowed is infuriating and makes you an easy pick. Alternative: Warpstone for escaping (teleport + bullet resist)
activeItems.useCase: Prevent escapes and shut down mobility heroes

activeItems.name: Warpstone
activeItems.effect: Quickly teleport in any direction and gain some bullet resist
activeItems.tips: Great option when your goal is escaping
activeItems.useCase: Escape tool alternative to Slowing Hex

activeItems.name: Disarming Hex
activeItems.effect: Disarms your target for 4 seconds and reduces their bullet resist
activeItems.tips: Use it to help with escaping or killing enemies
activeItems.useCase: Lifesaver that turns fights in your favor when enemy team is mostly weapon builds

activeItems.name: Silence Glyph
activeItems.effect: Launches a projectile forward, suppressing everyone in its path
activeItems.tips: Recommended against heroes relying on abilities. Especially effective against Lady Geist and Yamato who use ults at low health

activeItems.name: Mystic Reach
activeItems.effect: Point-and-click silence option. Passively increases fire rate by 16%. 30% of all damage dealt during silence gets applied when silence wears off
activeItems.tips: Fantastic point-and-click option to silence heroes
activeItems.useCase: Alternative silence with bonus fire rate

activeItems.name: Unstoppable
activeItems.effect: Automatic cancel spell that lasts for 5.5 seconds, deflecting all CC

activeItems.name: Curse
activeItems.effect: Silence, disarm and prevent item usage. Also interrupts channeled abilities
activeItems.tips: Best item to buy against fed people. Can cancel Dynamo's ult on a team

activeItems.name: Debuff Remover
activeItems.effect: Purges all non-ultimate negative effects that apply to you
activeItems.tips: Upgraded from Debuff Reducer. Priority buy against teams with multiple debuffs. Makes annoying actives like Slowing Hex and Knockdown irrelevant

antiHealItems.name: Heelsbane
antiHealItems.effect: Spirit damage applies 35% healing reduction. Heals you for 275 on kills
antiHealItems.tips: Fantastic early game option good on all heroes. Game-changing when struggling in lane against constant healing

antiHealItems.name: Toxic Bullet
antiHealItems.effect: Deals bleed damage (percentage of max health over time) and applies 30% healing reduction
antiHealItems.tips: 1600 more souls than Heelsbane but 5% less healing reduction. The bleed deals max health damage, making it great into beefy heroes like Tank Busters
antiHealItems.useCase: Anti-heal with % max health damage for tanks

antiHealItems.name: Inhibitor
antiHealItems.effect: 35% healing reduction (same as Heelsbane) + reduces target's outgoing damage by 35%
antiHealItems.tips: Big tier 4 item. Fantastic when an enemy hero is pumping damage while healing
antiHealItems.useCase: Dual-purpose: reduce healing and damage output

antiHealItems.name: Spirit Burn
antiHealItems.effect: Deals significant spirit damage with a burn that has 70% healing reduction
antiHealItems.tips: Double the Heelsbane healing reduction with insane damage. Value every game against spirit-building heroes
antiHealItems.useCase: Highest healing reduction in game + massive spirit damage

antiHealItems.name: Crippling Headshot
antiHealItems.effect: On headshot: reduces target's bullet resist and spirit resist by 18% for 12 seconds. Applies 30% healing reduction
antiHealItems.tips: Go-to for shutting down a fed Victor

bonusItems.name: Point Blank
bonusItems.effect: Point-and-click active that deals bleed damage based on target's current health. 40% healing reduction for 10 seconds
bonusItems.tips: Deals bleed damage based on current health
bonusItems.useCase: Burst anti-heal with current HP damage

bonusItems.name: Enduring Speed
bonusItems.effect: Offers movement speed and 30% slow resist

bonusItems.name: Close Quarters
bonusItems.effect: Offers 20% melee resist and 20% weapon damage in close range
bonusItems.useCase: Survive and trade in melee matchups

bonusItems.name: Divine Barrier
bonusItems.effect: Upgraded Debuff Remover that can be used on teammates. Can cleanse ultimates
bonusItems.useCase: Support item for saving teammates from ults

bonusItems.name: Suppressor
bonusItems.tips: Direct counter to weapon carries that rely on fire rate

bonusItems.name: Return Fire
bonusItems.effect: Has chance of firing bullets back to the attacker. Upgrades into Metal Skin
bonusItems.tips: Upgrades into Metal Skin (makes you immune to bullets for 5 seconds)
bonusItems.useCase: Reflect damage and upgrade path to bullet immunity

bonusItems.name: Metal Skin
bonusItems.effect: Active making you immune to bullets for 5 seconds

bonusItems.name: Rescue Beam
bonusItems.effect: Useful for saving teammates from many things
